en.title: [Korea Student Aid Foundation] Notice on Reorganization of Student Aid Section Calculation System
summary: Starting from the first semester of the 2027 academic year, the Korea Student Aid Foundation (한국장학재단) is reorganizing its student aid section calculation system.
The system will change from the existing 10-section system to a 5-section system ('Ga' to 'Ma').
Detailed information can be checked on the Korea Student Aid Foundation website announcement.
en.easyExplanation: Starting from the spring semester of 2027, the Korea Student Aid Foundation (한국장학재단) student aid section system will be reorganized from 10 tiers to 5 tiers ('Ga' through 'Ma'). Please keep this in mind when applying for student aid and scholarships.
en.target: Students subject to student aid section calculation (no specific eligibility conditions specified in the text)
